title.en: Classify business activities into industry and commerce
Distinguish primary, secondary and tertiary industries

say.en: Paddy grown in Mandya becomes rice in a mill, is carried by truck, stored in a godown, financed by a bank and sold in your local shop. Each step is a different kind of business activity. In this lesson: Classify business activities into industry and commerce.
Distinguish primary, secondary and tertiary industries.
Explain how auxiliaries to trade remove hindrances.

body.en: Primary industries are extractive (farming, mining, fishing, lumbering) or genetic (nurseries, poultry, fish hatcheries). Secondary industries are manufacturing, which can be analytical, synthetical, processing or assembling, and construction. Tertiary or service industries such as transport and banking support the other two.

title.en: On the board: Classification of business activities

narration.en: Business activities are of two kinds: industry, which makes goods, and commerce, which carries them to us.

say.en: Business activities are of two kinds: industry, which makes goods, and commerce, which carries them to us.
Industry has three branches: primary, secondary and tertiary.
Primary is extractive or genetic; secondary is manufacturing or construction; tertiary gives services.
Commerce is trade plus the auxiliaries to trade.
Each auxiliary removes one hindrance: transport removes place, warehousing removes time, and so on.

title.en: Commerce: trade and auxiliaries to trade

body.en: Commerce is trade plus the *auxiliaries to trade*. Trade is internal (wholesale and retail) or external (import, export and entrepot). The auxiliaries remove hindrances: transport removes place, warehousing removes time, insurance removes risk, banking removes finance, and advertising removes the hindrance of information.

problem.en: Classify each activity: (a) a sugar factory in Belagavi, (b) a car plant that puts together bought-out parts, (c) a fish hatchery, (d) a company that stores onions in cold storage.

steps.en: (a) Raw cane is processed through several stages: secondary, processing industry.
(b) Components are put together: secondary, assembling industry.
(c) Fish are bred for sale: primary, genetic industry.
(d) Storing goods until needed: commerce, auxiliary to trade (warehousing removes the hindrance of time).

say.en: Let us work through this case together. Classify each activity: a a sugar factory in Belagavi, b a car plant that puts together bought-out parts, c a fish hatchery, d a company that stores onions in cold storage.
a Raw cane is processed through several stages: secondary, processing industry.
b Components are put together: secondary, assembling industry.
c Fish are bred for sale: primary, genetic industry.
d Storing goods until needed: commerce, auxiliary to trade (warehousing removes the hindrance of time).
So the answer is a Processing; b assembling; c genetic; d warehousing.
